correspondences.notes: BIDS eye tracking is *_recording-eye1_physio.tsv.gz plus physio.json; ASC must be converted (e.g. eye2bids).

brainlife.desc: Eye-tracking recording in EyeLink ASCII (.asc) text, converted from EyeLink .edf: gaze position, pupil size and events.
brainlife.name: eyetrack/asc

original.desc: The eye-tracking data files naturally contain gaze position (x/y coordinates) and pupil size data.

brainlife.readme:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eggzTCzSHG3AEKhtnEDbcdk-2avXN6I94X8aUPEBVsw/edit#

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/eyetrack.asc.json

files.desc: EyeLink ASC text with samples (gaze x/y, pupil) and messages, converted from .edf.

identifying_risks: ASC header lists recording date/time and the original .edf file name.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level behavioural-physiological recording; step 5 if headers identify.
sharing_cautions: Strip header DATE and file-name lines before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the ASC header keeps the original file name or exact recording date that identify the participant.

intended_use: Archiving eye-tracking sessions alongside imaging data.
not_suitable_for: Processing on brainlife.io: no App reads this datatype yet.
BIDS export as-is: BIDS needs *_physio.tsv.gz and *_physio.json.
